landmarks.name: Rijksmuseum
landmarks.writeup: A Dutch national museum dedicated to arts and history in Amsterdam, housing masterpieces from the Dutch Golden Age.

landmarks.name: Anne Frank House
landmarks.writeup: Museum in Amsterdam preserving the hiding place where Anne Frank wrote her diary during World War II.

landmarks.name: Keukenhof Gardens
landmarks.writeup: One of the world's largest flower gardens, famous for its vibrant tulip displays in spring.

landmarks.name: Kinderdijk Windmills
landmarks.writeup: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring 19 historic windmills built for water management.

landmarks.name: Dam Square
landmarks.writeup: Central public square in Amsterdam known for the Royal Palace and National Monument.

cultural_events.name: King's Day
cultural_events.writeup: National holiday celebrating the king's birthday with nationwide festivities and orange-themed events.

cultural_events.name: Tulip Festival
cultural_events.writeup: Annual spring event showcasing the blooming tulips across various locations in the country.

cultural_events.name: Amsterdam Light Festival
cultural_events.writeup: Winter festival featuring light art installations throughout Amsterdam's canals.

cultural_events.name: Sinterklaas
cultural_events.writeup: Traditional December festivity celebrating Saint Nicholas with gift-giving and parades.

cultural_events.name: Carnival
cultural_events.writeup: Pre-Lenten festival with parades, costumes, and parties, especially popular in southern provinces.

food_writeup: Dutch cuisine features hearty dishes such as stamppot (mashed potatoes with vegetables), herring, and stroopwafels (caramel waffle cookies). Cheese, especially Gouda and Edam, is internationally renowned.
brief_history: The Netherlands emerged as a major maritime power in the 17th century during the Dutch Golden Age. It was a founding member of the EU and is known for its liberal policies and strong trade economy.
current_conflicts: The Netherlands is not involved in any active military conflicts but participates in international peacekeeping missions.
